description: She wears a burgundy floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow sleeves, over an ivory underdress. Gold geometric borders and round shoulder brooches decorate it; a narrow decorated belt with round clasp secures the waist. An ivory bordered wrap rests along the forearms, and brown embroidered shoes are visible below a modest lower walking opening. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
